title: StairFix
description: Fixes Minecrafts Stupid Stair Crafting Recipe
body:
# StairFix

Inspired by the viral short by **[GarrettTheCarrot](https://www.youtube.com/@GarrettTheCarrot)**, this plugin finally brings logic to Minecraft's stair crafting! 

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0ZI5RoCjE9I" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Get 4 stairs out of 3 blocks instead of wasting 6! 
The Plugin automatically scans and overrides all existing stair recipes on your server. It uses Minecraft's 1.13+ internal block tag system. Whether it's a new vanilla wood type added in future updates or custom stairs from server mods – if it's tagged as a stair, the recipe will automatically adjust! Means the plugin will support Every Stairs that will be added in the future.
